title: The tubes left alone, light behind the bars instead
question: Your correction: the tubes stay exactly as they were, and the light goes behind the OTHER bars - a meal row, the write-line. Three answers to what that light is for. Pick one, or steer.

options.label: Only the write-line
options.thesis: One lit thing on the whole screen: the line you write in. The light says where to begin, and nothing else on the page competes with it.
options.viewport: Tubes, water, three quiet meal rows, the lit write-line above the tab bar.
options.risk: The write-line has moved to the bottom of the screen here - close to the thumb, but further from the tubes it answers.

options.label: What you just added
options.thesis: The light marks the newest thing: Lunch was logged a minute ago, so Lunch carries it. It moves down the list as the day fills, and by evening it has gone out.
options.viewport: One lit meal row among three.
options.risk: Light that means 'recent' is close to the meaning you reserved it from - it has to fade, or it becomes 'used today' again.

options.label: Under every bar
options.thesis: Not a signal at all - material. Every raised bar is lifted a millimetre off the page and lit from under its own rim, so the whole screen has a warmth to it.
options.viewport: A line of warm light under the write-line, the three meal rows and the tab bar.
options.risk: If everything is lit, nothing is - and this is the version that costs the most to draw on a phone.
